newsitem.title: ESTONIA: VIRU RAND FORECASTS 1997 NET PROFIT AT 23 M EEK.
newsitem.headline: VIRU RAND FORECASTS 1997 NET PROFIT AT 23 M EEK.

text.p: Viru Rand, a fish processing company, has forecast its 1997 net profit at 23 million kroons and its total turnover at 320 million kroons, Baltic Cresco said on Tuesday.
Baltic Cresco is arranging the listing of Viru Rand on the Tallinn stock exchange.
"The company is forecasting 23 million kroons net profit and 320 million kroons for 1997," Indrek Rahumaa, head of corporate finance with Baltic Cresco, told Reuters.
The company's net profit for 1996 was five million kroons and its turnover was 250 million kroons, Baltic Cresco added.
In the first four months of the year, the company's turnover was 96.1 million kroons and profit was 8.6 million kroons.
"The company has improved its sales network to Russia and 70 percent of all of its production goes to Russia, Belarus and Ukraine," Rahumaa said.
"The other key change is that they now have contracts with 10 Russian wholesalers as opposed to the ad hoc arrangements previously," he added.
The company's sales have grown by over 25 percent over the last four years with 1995 bringing an increase of 35 percent and 1996 a 32 percent increase.
The company is also planning a new single production facility to replace its five separate plants requiring investment of 100 million kroons in 1998.
